title: Rethinking Black-Box On-Policy Distillation: A Rubric-based Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2605.07396v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for LLM post-training, yet its reliance on teacher logits restricts it to white-box teachers. In this paper, we study whether rubric-based supervision can provide a text-only feedback interface for black-box OPD, and what makes it effective. Our instantiation, Rubric-based On-Policy Distillation (ROPD), induces rubrics by contrasting teacher responses with the student's current rollouts and uses them to score these rollouts for on-policy optimization. We find that, under matched settings, text-only ROPD outperforms logit-based OPD methods on four competition-math benchmarks, reaching the best AIME24 accuracy of standard logit-based OPD with 9.6x fewer training samples. Our analysis yields three findings: rubric rewards track correctness far better than teacher log-likelihood (AUC 0.90 vs. 0.35); training with them repairs more failed criteria and regresses fewer passed ones th

translated_title: 重新思考黑盒在线策略蒸馏：基于评分标准的分析
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）是大语言模型后训练的一种强大范式，但其对教师模型logits的依赖将其限制在白盒教师模型上。在本文中，我们研究了基于评分标准的监督能否为黑盒OPD提供纯文本的反馈接口，以及是什么使其有效。我们的具体实现——基于评分标准的在线策略蒸馏（ROPD）——通过对比教师模型的回答与学生模型当前的采样结果来生成评分标准，并使用这些标准对采样结果进行评分以进行在线策略优化。我们发现，在匹配的设置下，纯文本的ROPD在四个竞赛数学基准上优于基于logits的OPD方法，仅用1/9.6的训练样本就达到了标准基于logits的OPD所能取得的最佳AIME24准确率。我们的分析得出三个发现：评分标准奖励比教师对数似然能更好地追踪答案正确性（AUC 0.90 对比 0.35）；使用评分标准进行训练能修复更多未通过的评判标准，同时减少已通过标准的退化……
tldr: 该论文提出基于评分标准的在线策略蒸馏（ROPD），通过对比教师回答与学生采样结果自动生成评分标准作为纯文本反馈，使黑盒教师模型也能进行在线策略蒸馏，并以少9.6倍的训练样本在竞赛数学基准上超越了基于logits的白盒OPD方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Rubric-based On-Policy Distillation (ROPD), which generates rubrics by contrasting teacher responses with student rollouts as a text-only feedback interface, enabling black-box on-policy distillation that outperforms logit-based white-box OPD methods with 9.6x fewer training samples on competition math benchmarks.
